text: My partner left me and I don't know how to cope with the emptiness.
We broke up after five years together and I'm completely heartbroken.
I'm drowning in deadlines and I think I'm heading for burnout.
My boss keeps piling on more work and I genuinely can't keep up.
My mind is racing and I can't stop worrying about everything at once.
I feel panicky and my thoughts keep spiraling, I can't slow down.
I feel so alone, like I have no one I can actually talk to.
Everyone seems to have close friends except me, I feel so isolated.
I feel flat and unmotivated and I can barely get out of bed.
Everything feels grey and pointless lately, I have no energy.
My best friend and I had a big argument and things are really tense.
My partner and I keep fighting about money and it's exhausting.
